# Macau Sauna Sites

> Independent multilingual editorial guide to Macau sauna and spa venues, practical visit planning, venue status, and travel information.

This file is generated during every production build. Venue availability and commercial details can change; use the linked pages as editorial references and confirm time-sensitive details before travel.

## Published Articles

- [Macau Sauna Market Update — September 2026: Yu Sauna Opens, Victoria Returns and Nine Major Venues Assessed](https://macao-sex.com/en/blog/macau-sauna-market-update-september-2026/): English; published 2026-09-01. Macau's sauna market shifted again in September 2026 as Yu Sauna launched with a 100-plus roster and Victoria Sauna reopened under a new team. This update assesses Empire, Shang Pin, Majesty, Manhao, East Castle, Number Nine and The Excellent, covering the latest observed line-ups, promotions and venue-selection guidance.
- [Macau Sauna Overnight Guide 2026: Free Rest, Dining, Open Venues and How to Choose](https://macao-sex.com/en/blog/macau-sauna-overnight-guide-2026/): English; published 2026-08-11. Macau hotel rates aren't cheap, and some sauna venues offer overnight lounge recliners plus bathing and dining packages. This 2026 guide covers overnight arrangements at Majesty Spa, Shang Pin Spa, Number Nine Spa, Victoria Sauna and Empire Sauna, the closed-venue list, free vs paid rest rooms, the full overnight flow and key precautions.
- [Macau Sauna August 2026 Guide: 7 Venues Reviewed — Prices, Deals and Pitfalls](https://macao-sex.com/en/blog/macau-sauna-august-guide-2026/): English; published 2026-07-26. Macau's sauna scene has largely recovered by August 2026. This guide covers the latest status, price references, promotions, recommended arrival times and spending pitfalls for Majesty Spa, Shang Pin Spa, Empire Sauna, East Castle Spa, The Excellent Sauna, Manhao Spa and Number Nine Spa.

## Current Venue Guides

- [Clube Rio](https://macao-sex.com/en/spa/clube-rio/): Editorial guide for a venue currently listed as operating. Clube Rio is a business-KTV club on the third floor of Hotel Rio in NAPE, with private karaoke rooms and spa options.
- [Yu Sauna](https://macao-sex.com/en/spa/yu-sauna/): Editorial guide for a venue currently listed as operating. Yu Sauna is a NAPE venue inside New Orient Landmark Hotel, with dry and steam rooms, showers, a hot pool and a recliner lounge.
- [Manhao Spa](https://macao-sex.com/en/spa/manhao-spa/): Editorial guide for a venue currently listed as operating. Manhao Spa is a Taipa venue inside Grandview Hotel, with marble-and-gold interiors, a showcase hall and private treatment rooms.
- [Number Nine Spa](https://macao-sex.com/en/spa/number-nine-sauna/): Editorial guide for a venue currently listed as operating. Number Nine Spa is located inside the Royal Dragon Hotel and is one of the new venues in central Macau attracting considerable attention in 2026.
- [Shang Pin Spa](https://macao-sex.com/en/spa/shang-pin-spa/): Editorial guide for a venue currently listed as operating. Shang Pin Spa is located at L2 R95 on the second floor of Lisboeta Macau and is one of the newer upscale spa venues in Cotai.
- [Majesty Spa](https://macao-sex.com/en/spa/majesty-spa/): Editorial guide for a venue currently listed as operating. Majesty Spa is located inside Harbourview Hotel at Macau Fisherman's Wharf and focuses on an opulent setting and comfortable overnight stays.
- [The Excellent Sauna](https://macao-sex.com/en/spa/the-excellent-sauna/): Editorial guide for a venue currently listed as operating. The Excellent Sauna is tucked inside the Grand Emperor Hotel on the Macau Peninsula and follows a boutique themed-room concept.
- [Empire Sauna](https://macao-sex.com/en/spa/empire-sauna/): Editorial guide for a venue currently listed as operating. Empire Sauna is a Macau Peninsula venue with a modern, Eastern-influenced interior and a flow built around bathing, private rooms, dining and rest.
- [East Castle Spa](https://macao-sex.com/en/spa/east-castle-spa/): Editorial guide for a venue currently listed as operating. East Castle Spa is memorable not because the venue is extravagant, but because it turns its “theme” into a complete experience.
- [Victoria Sauna](https://macao-sex.com/en/spa/victoria-sauna/): Editorial guide for a venue currently listed as operating. Victoria Sauna is a low-key Macau sauna.

## Temporarily Closed Venue References

- [M CLUB](https://macao-sex.com/en/spa/m-club/): Reference only; the site currently lists this venue as temporarily closed. MCLUB has a clear positioning: rather than following the traditional large-pool-and-lobby format, it focuses on a tech-forward look, a party atmosphere and themed rooms.
- [Number One Sauna](https://macao-sex.com/en/spa/number-one-sauna/): Reference only; the site currently lists this venue as temporarily closed. Number One Sauna is marked temporarily closed; this profile retains its former facilities and service details for historical reference.
- [Familia Nobre](https://macao-sex.com/en/spa/familia-nobre/): Reference only; the site currently lists this venue as temporarily closed. Familia Nobre is a temporarily closed Macau Peninsula venue; this profile is retained for historical reference.
- [Oceanic Royal Spa](https://macao-sex.com/en/spa/oceanic-royal-spa/): Reference only; the site currently lists this venue as temporarily closed. Oceanic Royal Spa is a Taipa venue shaped around an evening-in-one-place experience.
- [18 Sauna](https://macao-sex.com/en/spa/eighteen-sauna/): Reference only; the site currently lists this venue as temporarily closed. 18 Sauna formerly operated on the sixth floor of Hotel Golden Dragon on the Macau Peninsula.
